### Hoping Against All Hope
Author: Kelly Balarie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/hoping-against-all-hope-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Romans 4:18
Points:
- Abraham chose to maintain hope even when all natural circumstances appeared impossible.
- True biblical hope rests on believing God creates out of nothing and brings dead things back to life.
- Believers walk by faith when they refuse to give up in the face of spiritual attacks and worldly obstacles.
- Keeping hope alive means trusting God to fulfill His promises in His own way and timing.

### Do You Have a Small View of God?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-27-2024.html
Passage: Romans 4:18-21
Points:
- Weak faith frequently stems from an inadequate, small understanding of God.
- Believers should briefly glance at their problems while keeping their steady gaze on the Lord.
- Abraham trusted in the God who calls life out of death and creates something from nothing.
- Freedom from despair comes when people abandon self-reliance and place all their hope in God.

### Growing Strong in Your Faith
Author: Mark Altrogge
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/growing-strong-in-your-faith-bible-study-minute-march-26-2018.html
Passage: Romans 4:20
Points:
- Faith grows stronger when believers fix their attention on God’s promises rather than distressing circumstances.
- Believers must rely on God's gospel promise of imputed righteousness rather than their own feelings of unworthiness.
- Abraham strengthened his faith through the active practice of praising and giving glory to God.
- Believers overcome wavering emotions by remaining fully persuaded of God’s power to do what He said.

### Persevering, Strengthening Faith
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/persevering-strengthening-faith
Passage: Romans 4:18-21
Points:
- Scripture presents Abraham as the model demonstrating that justification has always been by faith alone.
- Believing against hope was not a blind leap into darkness, but a rational trust in the almighty Creator.
- Abraham's faith experienced struggles, yet it was never permanently overcome by unbelief.
- Justifying faith is an enduring faith that perseveres and matures through difficulties.
